cleaning_policy: Sort dates; collapse identical selected-rate duplicates, reject conflicting duplicates; drop missing/non-finite/non-positive rate rows with full audit; never forward fill; preserve flagged extreme returns; use actual calendar gaps.
scope: Historical FX reference data calibrate volatility only. Synthetic $100 price-normalized instruments demonstrate the unchanged execution core. Impact, risk preference and intraday diffusion remain assumptions. No real-trade backtest.
holdout_policy: Freeze training on 2022-2023; evaluate 2024-2025. Rolling parameters use returns ending no later than the previous reference date. Current historical snapshot is not a point-in-time vintage.
